name: Fires At Midnight
source:
In a world where making love without being in love will make you spontaneously combust, the person you love most may be the one who burns you!

You play as Yun, an up-and-coming photographer struggling to balance his life and the relationship with his live-in girlfriend, Chitra.

Uncover the story of their relationship from the perspective of two characters – recalling memories by fiddling through Yun’s things, looking at newspaper headlines, playing mini-games and listening to different music.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282140/Fires_At_Midnight/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在這個世界裡，沒有愛意的性愛會讓人自燃。你最愛的人，或許正是將你焚燬的那個人！

你將扮演嶄露頭角的攝影師Yun，努力在個人生活與同居女友Chitra之間尋找平衡。

從兩位角色的視角，揭開他們之間的感情故事。翻看Yun的物品、閱讀報紙頭條、遊玩小遊戲、聆聽不同的音樂，在這些過程中喚起回憶。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282140/Fires_At_Midnight/]Steam[/url]］
